parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name that is protected by WAF. If you do not specify this parameter, security events for all domain names are queried.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **5**. Valid values: 1 to 200.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: a region outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
